There is no clinically established or FDA-approved therapeutic dosage for dihydromyricetin (DHM) in humans, though **300 to 1,000 mg daily** is commonly cited in supplement use and preliminary research.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXXF8NHC4WAzn7txs7shX-viJOsuP0SvkRe07a79MW5YsTqf_RxhoaSNe9v2diq5DpHu-VGreJrwVsY6kn9PBKg76VBy9pTAozuHi5GBVXgILBdOgYmygl9FYinTLhKhR2ncWW_ag)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpQEBxCJF16VAqRilpPNLJ4AuyUfgn9EeJOvP21dihx7oVqoFFc2vLn0nALY3gnhKI44QqLEwF3CLMnPCK1R_S9Q-nCkzo87sEidiCDPbq0ETodl_IXIvcPoRPjg4ocx0Ts3fRU2fPshOK8r1PkiBu4MdI-BT5et0sMuRYN_gvpSq_CzymZjadBI-SZXx-5LxkLcMJjGhGSRHin0bMzmR8oVNnPPG67M)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF12s5auUwjfpsaDrxoBQ23zj1SOYH6RmC0njtJAObK9R6a6G7M0yns8xdnr01m0fuB_UFam38sYme83bSF-ypKBdGkRAlWcWwz2u2Rke-1wdvwxjNaveO6i5VovpwkCZm4YrtUckEB7kEPLcMKalRpF9ZgnP9pu1Cj7aGLuaqboDbwfvaA16fb_9Urg)

Because human trials are limited and DHM has low bioavailability, optimal dosing depends heavily on the specific product formulation and intended use.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXNJq-EGqT1o9buCyDZclPYEcdxL7XMaozhoiNNxue4Dq7lUptpVcCBTqPN5VfJjEg38Wrs2gwA7BbOn86OYJiQvJdBh1x6Xi6Dq65nDRRV40qMvIHb93jZc7Z9xv0DOIgkcbqBQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF12s5auUwjfpsaDrxoBQ23zj1SOYH6RmC0njtJAObK9R6a6G7M0yns8xdnr01m0fuB_UFam38sYme83bSF-ypKBdGkRAlWcWwz2u2Rke-1wdvwxjNaveO6i5VovpwkCZm4YrtUckEB7kEPLcMKalRpF9ZgnP9pu1Cj7aGLuaqboDbwfvaA16fb_9Urg)

### Common Dosing Patterns

- **General / Daily Supplementation:** Often ranges from **300 to 1,000 mg per day** . In one small clinical trial for non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, participants took **150 mg twice daily** (300 mg total) for three months.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF12s5auUwjfpsaDrxoBQ23zj1SOYH6RmC0njtJAObK9R6a6G7M0yns8xdnr01m0fuB_UFam38sYme83bSF-ypKBdGkRAlWcWwz2u2Rke-1wdvwxjNaveO6i5VovpwkCZm4YrtUckEB7kEPLcMKalRpF9ZgnP9pu1Cj7aGLuaqboDbwfvaA16fb_9Urg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXXF8NHC4WAzn7txs7shX-viJOsuP0SvkRe07a79MW5YsTqf_RxhoaSNe9v2diq5DpHu-VGreJrwVsY6kn9PBKg76VBy9pTAozuHi5GBVXgILBdOgYmygl9FYinTLhKhR2ncWW_ag)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpQEBxCJF16VAqRilpPNLJ4AuyUfgn9EeJOvP21dihx7oVqoFFc2vLn0nALY3gnhKI44QqLEwF3CLMnPCK1R_S9Q-nCkzo87sEidiCDPbq0ETodl_IXIvcPoRPjg4ocx0Ts3fRU2fPshOK8r1PkiBu4MdI-BT5et0sMuRYN_gvpSq_CzymZjadBI-SZXx-5LxkLcMJjGhGSRHin0bMzmR8oVNnPPG67M)
- **Occasional / Hangover Use:** Over-the-counter supplements vary widely, frequently suggesting single or divided doses roughly in the **300 to 1,200 mg** range around alcohol consumption.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXX8PPMKZ8eu4_33d3jPJJuMSPWyHPuOJfS8pS58PWBw3bqYk6KMlnd4WdENZa3ob6oLLKSU9TAESrwLEdvnXQcn-1dnQnNfL8WJezSFB2h62pG6AaENrg_SpncMzH-SCllBByY2_ZV4rGmSLk)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX3rr4ie7ELUGNfo7f8xgwiBEV_DzdrwU1fWGsIN0y5oKgk4a-L15cZirok1YZCDw25v4AKwSwndxkVbqxvnG0_xUuxmN3Pmk7_h45kFZATma_K3WBWkwCs7gNnG93rBEbTGYsOW7G)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXRtxtNwUKZhQ3UZwIG1tHAKUwBL7Ogxi8VS85flBrQMjo1HD5eBf0OdVFb7yUmEMNt7O9WLz9Q-oQQkvAoUb43iWM2nYQnD0-_XYkbEKm_28EgWjtiUUJvAvsyVNDykN9bJ5EpDtcWrqjlAaRHy47a4_59JPcuU8sXV4)
- **Clinical Research:** Early human trials have tested doses such as **300 mg to 900 mg** in dose-escalation studies.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXNJq-EGqT1o9buCyDZclPYEcdxL7XMaozhoiNNxue4Dq7lUptpVcCBTqPN5VfJjEg38Wrs2gwA7BbOn86OYJiQvJdBh1x6Xi6Dq65nDRRV40qMvIHb93jZc7Z9xv0DOIgkcbqBQ)

### Safety & Practical Considerations

- **Long-Term Safety Unknown:** Short-term studies have generally reported minimal side effects, but long-term daily safety in humans is not well established.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpQEBxCJF16VAqRilpPNLJ4AuyUfgn9EeJOvP21dihx7oVqoFFc2vLn0nALY3gnhKI44QqLEwF3CLMnPCK1R_S9Q-nCkzo87sEidiCDPbq0ETodl_IXIvcPoRPjg4ocx0Ts3fRU2fPshOK8r1PkiBu4MdI-BT5et0sMuRYN_gvpSq_CzymZjadBI-SZXx-5LxkLcMJjGhGSRHin0bMzmR8oVNnPPG67M)
- **Drug & Receptor Interactions:** Lab data suggests DHM may affect liver enzymes (such as CYP3A4, CYP2E1, and CYP2D6) and interact with GABA receptors, meaning it could potentially alter medication levels or add to the effects of sedatives or anti-anxiety drugs.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpQEBxCJF16VAqRilpPNLJ4AuyUfgn9EeJOvP21dihx7oVqoFFc2vLn0nALY3gnhKI44QqLEwF3CLMnPCK1R_S9Q-nCkzo87sEidiCDPbq0ETodl_IXIvcPoRPjg4ocx0Ts3fRU2fPshOK8r1PkiBu4MdI-BT5et0sMuRYN_gvpSq_CzymZjadBI-SZXx-5LxkLcMJjGhGSRHin0bMzmR8oVNnPPG67M)
- **Supplement Quality:** Because DHM is sold as a dietary supplement rather than an approved drug in the U.S., potency, purity, and bioavailability can differ substantially between brands.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXXF8NHC4WAzn7txs7shX-viJOsuP0SvkRe07a79MW5YsTqf_RxhoaSNe9v2diq5DpHu-VGreJrwVsY6kn9PBKg76VBy9pTAozuHi5GBVXgILBdOgYmygl9FYinTLhKhR2ncWW_ag)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXNJq-EGqT1o9buCyDZclPYEcdxL7XMaozhoiNNxue4Dq7lUptpVcCBTqPN5VfJjEg38Wrs2gwA7BbOn86OYJiQvJdBh1x6Xi6Dq65nDRRV40qMvIHb93jZc7Z9xv0DOIgkcbqBQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpQEBxCJF16VAqRilpPNLJ4AuyUfgn9EeJOvP21dihx7oVqoFFc2vLn0nALY3gnhKI44QqLEwF3CLMnPCK1R_S9Q-nCkzo87sEidiCDPbq0ETodl_IXIvcPoRPjg4ocx0Ts3fRU2fPshOK8r1PkiBu4MdI-BT5et0sMuRYN_gvpSq_CzymZjadBI-SZXx-5LxkLcMJjGhGSRHin0bMzmR8oVNnPPG67M)

You can review clinical literature on DHM's safety and liver profile in the [LiverTox](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXXF8NHC4WAzn7txs7shX-viJOsuP0SvkRe07a79MW5YsTqf_RxhoaSNe9v2diq5DpHu-VGreJrwVsY6kn9PBKg76VBy9pTAozuHi5GBVXgILBdOgYmygl9FYinTLhKhR2ncWW_ag) database, or explore ongoing research details via [ClinicalTrials.gov](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXNJq-EGqT1o9buCyDZclPYEcdxL7XMaozhoiNNxue4Dq7lUptpVcCBTqPN5VfJjEg38Wrs2gwA7BbOn86OYJiQvJdBh1x6Xi6Dq65nDRRV40qMvIHb93jZc7Z9xv0DOIgkcbqBQ) . Consulting a healthcare provider or pharmacist before starting DHM is especially important if you take regular medications or have liver concerns.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXXF8NHC4WAzn7txs7shX-viJOsuP0SvkRe07a79MW5YsTqf_RxhoaSNe9v2diq5DpHu-VGreJrwVsY6kn9PBKg76VBy9pTAozuHi5GBVXgILBdOgYmygl9FYinTLhKhR2ncWW_ag)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXNJq-EGqT1o9buCyDZclPYEcdxL7XMaozhoiNNxue4Dq7lUptpVcCBTqPN5VfJjEg38Wrs2gwA7BbOn86OYJiQvJdBh1x6Xi6Dq65nDRRV40qMvIHb93jZc7Z9xv0DOIgkcbqBQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpQEBxCJF16VAqRilpPNLJ4AuyUfgn9EeJOvP21dihx7oVqoFFc2vLn0nALY3gnhKI44QqLEwF3CLMnPCK1R_S9Q-nCkzo87sEidiCDPbq0ETodl_IXIvcPoRPjg4ocx0Ts3fRU2fPshOK8r1PkiBu4MdI-BT5et0sMuRYN_gvpSq_CzymZjadBI-SZXx-5LxkLcMJjGhGSRHin0bMzmR8oVNnPPG67M)Are you looking into DHM for a specific goal—such as **occasional drinking**, **liver support** , or **general wellness** —or checking for **potential interactions** with medications?
